capabilities: Send a note or text selection to the Noctua podcast feed
Write noctua_id and noctua_url frontmatter properties to mark sent notes
Browse episodes in the Noctua feed and pick ones to save
Save episode transcripts as notes in a designated transcript folder
Test the API connection and show remaining credits
extras: Credit-based paid service: each conversion consumes one Noctua credit, though new accounts include free credits. The README includes a detailed network and privacy disclosure and requires Obsidian 1.13.0+; the API key is stored in Obsidian's secret storage rather than the plugin's data.json.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to turn a note's text into listenable audio you can consume on the go through a podcast app.

relations.evidence: Send any note (or selection) to Noctua and listen to it later as an episode in your personal podcast feed.

summary: Sends notes or selections to the Noctua service, which converts them to text-to-speech audio episodes in a personal podcast feed, and saves transcripts back to the vault.
